statement_en: Let ℓ be a prime and B a finite set of residues modulo ℓ. Count the residues that can be written as x + y with x and y two DIFFERENT elements of B. Show that this count is at least the smaller of 2|B| − 3 and ℓ.
statement_lean:
theorem erdos_94163 (ℓ : ℕ) (hℓ : Nat.Prime ℓ) (B : Finset (ZMod ℓ)) :
    min (2 * (B.card : ℤ) - 3) (ℓ : ℤ) ≤
      ((((B ×ˢ B).filter (fun w : ZMod ℓ × ZMod ℓ => w.1 ≠ w.2)).image
          (fun w : ZMod ℓ × ZMod ℓ => w.1 + w.2)).card : ℤ) := by
  sorry
